seed_ledger.name: Schlachter Realty Data Center Power Station
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: the project is real. A Texas air permit notice for the Wilmer site (permit 184454) lists 891 Caterpillar engines described as emergency generators, and no gas supplier or pipe is named. It is not clear the engines burn gas. Searches found no Atmos Pipeline Texas, Energy Transfer or other gas lateral for the site. Searches run: 9. Sources checked: the state air permit notice (project and engines only), an Inside Climate News report (project listed, no gas supply), Dallas area local news and data center directories for Wilmer (other developers, nothing on Schlachter), Railroad Commission pipeline permit pages (general rules only), the federal energy regulator, EIA pipeline project workbook and utility filings (nothing found).

evidence.note: State air permit notice for Wilmer, 891 Caterpillar engines, no gas supply named
Report listing the project, no pipeline named

seed_ledger.name: Titus data center power park
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: Titus signed for 673 MW of gas engines from AB Energy for several planned Texas power parks, with first power in late 2027. No site, county or gas supplier has been disclosed, so no pipe can be tied to it. Searches run: 8. Sources checked: a Data Center Dynamics report on the engine deal (equipment and timing only), a Fort Worth Report story and press release reposts (company plans, no sites), trade press such as Power Technology and Energy Tech (same facts), searches for Titus with specific Texas counties (nothing), the Railroad Commission, the state air permit lists, the federal energy regulator and the EIA workbook (nothing found).

evidence.note: 673 MW gas engine supply deal, no site or gas supplier named

seed_ledger.name: VoltaGrid power plant (San Antonio)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: VoltaGrid gas plants serve two Vantage data center sites on the west side of San Antonio, about 423 MW of gas plus diesel backup, now the subject of a federal lawsuit over air permits. No source names the gas supplier or a lateral. Searches run: 10. Sources checked: Data Center Dynamics and Microgrid Knowledge reports on the VoltaGrid and Vantage deal and the lawsuit (equipment and permits only), the Sierra Club, Environmental Integrity Project and law firm notices (air permit issues, no gas supply), the Texas Tribune, TDLR project records for the Vantage buildings (building details only), Railroad Commission pages, CPS Energy and Atmos searches, and the EIA workbook (nothing found). The Abilene VoltaGrid plant is a different seed.

evidence.note: Lawsuit over the San Antonio gas plants, no gas supply named
VoltaGrid and Vantage deal, no pipeline named
